name: reach-source-check
description: Checks the source behind each fact for who published it, whether it is the original, the date on the page and whether the page says what the fact claims, with disagreements shown side by side and a keep, fix or drop per fact. Use for "run reach-source-check", "source check", "check my sources", "is this source reliable", "verify this fact", "where did this fact come from", "fact check my research", "SIFT check", part of the Claude Guide for Outreach Pack by 90n.
